pr_title: Fix small buffer handling with the Platform Crypto Provider
pr_body:
When using the Platform Crypto Provider with CNG, it returns different a different error code for "buffer too small".

This means for `Try*` APIs we will throw an exception when we should be returning false. For allocating-return APIs, this would mean we throw instead of returning a right sized buffer.

This change allows handling `TPM_E_PCP_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` in places we were also handling `NTE_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL`.

Fixes #80444.

issue_context.title: RSA.SignHash does not reliably work with the Platform Crypto Provider
issue_context.body:
In places we handle "buffer too small" for RSA signing, this does not work with the the Platform Crypto Provider in most cases. For example:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d4907cf8fb4800b4ec96d07cd93be58eb479a2e6/src/libraries/System.Security.Cryptography/src/System/Security/Cryptography/CngCommon.SignVerify.cs#L30-L34

Signing with a too-small buffer with the Platform Crypto Provider returns a different `SECURITY_STATUS`. It returns `TPM_E_PCP_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` (0x80290406), not `NTE_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL`.

We should look at places where we check for `NTE_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` and also handle `TPM_E_PCP_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` as appropriate for the Platform Crypto Provider.
